output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function does not check for overflow of the 'balances[_to]' variable, allowing users to transfer more tokens than the contract owner has.
The 'approve' function does not check if there is already an allowance set for the spender, allowing users to overwrite the allowance of another user.
The 'transferFrom' function does not check if the spender has enough allowance, allowing users to transfer tokens from another user without their permission.
The initial token distribution is set by the owner, allowing the owner to mint new tokens at any time.
The 'onlyOwner' modifier does not restrict access to the owner, allowing any user to become the owner.
